senses.sense_definition: Lacking interesting or distinctive features that make something easy to recognize.

examples.text: The suspect escaped in a <w>nondescript</w> grey van that no one could identify.

target_lang_translations.zh: 嫌疑人开着一辆<w>平淡无奇</w>的灰色货车逃跑了，没人能认出那辆车。

examples.text: She lived in a <w>nondescript</w> apartment building that looked exactly like all the others on the street.

target_lang_translations.zh: 她住在一栋<w>毫无特色</w>的公寓楼里，看起来和街上其他的楼房一模一样。

target_lang_definitions.zh: 缺乏显著特征，难以辨认或引人注目的。

zh.target_lang_sense_clarification: 形容事物普通，没有特色。

senses.sense_definition: Not yet formally documented or categorized in academic or scientific literature.

examples.text: The biologist discovered a <w>nondescript</w> insect species in the remote rainforest.

target_lang_translations.zh: 生物学家在偏远的雨林中发现了一种<w>未被描述的</w>昆虫。

examples.text: Many deep-sea organisms remain <w>nondescript</w> due to the difficulty of exploring the ocean floor.

target_lang_translations.zh: 由于深海探测难度大，许多深海生物至今仍处于<w>未被描述</w>的状态。

target_lang_definitions.zh: 尚未在学术或科学文献中被正式记录或分类的。

zh.target_lang_sense_clarification: 指科学上尚未命名或记录的物种。

senses.sense_definition: A person or thing that is ordinary and lacks any special qualities.

examples.text: The crowd was filled with <w>nondescripts</w> who blended perfectly into the busy city background.

target_lang_translations.zh: 人群中挤满了<w>平庸之辈</w>，他们完美地融入了繁忙的城市背景中。

examples.text: He felt like a total <w>nondescript</w> at the party, as nobody seemed to notice him.

target_lang_translations.zh: 他在聚会上觉得自己完全是个<w>平庸之辈</w>，似乎没人注意到他。

target_lang_definitions.zh: 平庸、缺乏特殊品质的人或事物。

zh.target_lang_sense_clarification: 指普通且没有特点的人。

senses.sense_definition: A vehicle used by law enforcement that does not have visible markings or lights.

examples.text: The officer pulled the speeding driver over using an unmarked <w>nondescript</w>.

target_lang_translations.zh: 警察开着一辆<w>便衣警车</w>拦下了超速行驶的司机。

examples.text: Detectives often prefer using a <w>nondescript</w> to conduct surveillance without being noticed.

target_lang_translations.zh: 侦探们通常更喜欢使用<w>便衣警车</w>进行监视，以免被发现。

target_lang_definitions.zh: 执法部门使用的没有明显标志或警灯的车辆。

zh.target_lang_sense_clarification: 指外观普通、无明显标识的警用车辆。

senses.sense_definition: A living creature that has not been previously identified or classified by science.

examples.text: The expedition team struggled to classify the strange <w>nondescript</w> they found in the cave.

target_lang_translations.zh: 探险队很难对他们在洞穴中发现的那种奇怪的<w>未分类生物</w>进行归类。

examples.text: Taxonomists are still debating the origin of the mysterious <w>nondescript</w> captured on camera.

target_lang_translations.zh: 分类学家们仍在争论镜头中捕捉到的那种神秘<w>未分类生物</w>的起源。

target_lang_definitions.zh: 科学上尚未被识别或分类的生物。

zh.target_lang_sense_clarification: 指尚未被科学界定名的生物个体。
